integrity.proof_basis: Finite polynomial cancellation and the adjoint Toeplitz norm identity; no finite computation is used to prove a universal statement.
integrity.supplementary_checks: The standalone stdlib checker tests 726 exact Gaussian-integer matrix entries over six examples.

scientific_limitations: The denominator must have all roots on the unit circle; no off-circle denominator is covered.
This is a structural transformed-Gram identity, not an explicit formula for all orthonormal polynomials.
The rank at most twice the denominator degree is an upper bound, not an exact rank classification.
The result has not received independent mathematical audit; an unindexed equivalent earlier identity cannot be ruled out.
title: An exact Toeplitz band for every boundary-pole de Branges–Rovnyak Gram matrix
